description: Load the working-style skill into context at session start, after /clear and after compaction.

hooks.command:
d="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/working-style"; printf '<working-style>
The working-style skill is loaded automatically; follow it on every task. Its fragments are in %s/references/ (read one only when its trigger applies).

' "$d"; awk 'f>=2; /^---$/{f++}' "$d/SKILL.md"; printf '</working-style>
'
hooks.commandWindows: [Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $d="$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT\skills\working-style"; "<working-style>`nThe working-style skill is loaded automatically; follow it on every task. Its fragments are in $d\references\ (read one only when its trigger applies).`n"; (Get-Content -Raw -Encoding UTF8 "$d\SKILL.md") -replace '(?s)^---.*?\n---\r?\n',''; '</working-style>'
